Use cases

Use Gomentum when the task feels too big to enter.

Gomentum can support work, study, life admin, cleaning, creative tasks, and other moments where you know what to do but cannot begin.

Work tasks

You have a work task open in your mind, but the first step feels unclear.

TaskPrepare the weekly report
First moveOpen the report file and write only the section headings.
Try this kind of task

Study tasks

You need to study, but the material feels too large to enter.

TaskRevise cardiovascular pharmacology
First moveOpen the notes and highlight only one heading you recognize.
Try this kind of task

Life admin

Small personal tasks have piled up and now feel heavier than they are.

TaskReply to an important email
First moveOpen the email and write only the greeting.
Try this kind of task

Cleaning tasks

The room feels overwhelming because everything looks like one big task.

TaskClean my room
First movePut only the clothes from the chair into one basket.
Try this kind of task

Creative tasks

You want to create something, but the blank page makes starting feel hard.

TaskWrite a new article
First moveWrite three rough bullet points without editing them.
Try this kind of task

Overwhelming tasks

The task has too many parts, so your brain avoids the whole thing.

TaskPlan next week
First moveWrite down only three things that must happen first.
Try this kind of task

Use it before the pressure builds.

The best moment to use Gomentum is when you notice yourself avoiding the first step.
